XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine stalling while driving with no possibility of restarting
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | STARTING | START | PART | ENGINE RUNS | WILL NOT START | CONTROL UNIT | U0426 | MINIKRYPT ERROR |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: While driving, the engine suddenly shut down. Initially, the engine would start, but would shut down shortly afterwards. Subsequently, the engine turns over but fails to start. The problem has become permanent.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U0426 (Minikrypt error - no signal)

  • Cause: Faulty injection control unit

• Intervention: Replacement of the injection control unit

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: - -
